title: The Psychology of Money
author: Morgan Housel
summary: Morgan Housel argues that how you behave with money matters more than how much you know about it. He gathers short stories on risk, luck, greed and enough to show why good financial habits are mostly personal.
readIf: you want short, jargon-free essays on the habits and emotions behind money decisions.
skipIf: you want a step-by-step investing or budgeting manual.
